title: K0 role-neutral denominator Wave 05 · publication gates

source_plane.coverage_claim: bounded first-page discovery pass over publication suppression, research-misconduct correction, authorship adjudication, scientific-integrity reporting, and publication-record controls; not a complete publication-dispute universe and not evidence of absence outside the observed return set

query_executions.query_text: site:news.ki.se publication withdrawn authors internal inquiry misconduct
site:caut.ca publication confidentiality sponsor academic freedom inquiry report
site:oir.nih.gov OR site:hhs.gov publication authorship conflict scientific integrity policy

records.matter: Clinical-research misconduct warnings, internal handling, external inquiry, and publication correction
records.qualification_basis: Clinical researchers and coauthors with direct access to patient outcomes, records, manuscripts, and the disputed research.

source_packets.supports: External review found misconduct, said raw data had been withheld, and led the institution to apologize for prior handling of whistleblowers.
The inquiry identified serious recruitment, management, leadership, and control failures in the institutional handling of the matter.
The institution requested retraction of six articles after misconduct review.

records.source_supports: Qualified clinical and research warnings were mishandled within an institution that later reversed course after external inquiry and sought publication correction.
source_does_not_establish: one bounded publication decisionmaker and one exact pre-publication or withdrawal transaction
a complete explanation-before and explanation-after ratchet applied to a named knower
the full employment, access, retaliation, and appeal record for each whistleblower
a complete continuous K0 chain without field-level adjudication

records.matter: Sponsor confidentiality, patient-safety disclosure, publication pressure, and institutional review in a clinical drug trial
records.institution: Apotex / Hospital for Sick Children / University of Toronto
records.qualification_basis: A principal clinical investigator responsible for interpreting trial evidence, informing patients, and publishing safety-relevant findings.

source_packets.supports: CAUT criticized the institutional review process and described unresolved scientific, contractual, and academic-freedom issues surrounding the dispute.
CAUT argued that the hospital review should stop because its terms and process could not provide an independent resolution.
The association reported that an independent inquiry vindicated the researcher and criticized sponsor and institutional treatment.

records.source_supports: A clinical safety and publication dispute involved sponsor confidentiality claims, patient disclosure, research continuation, institutional review, and professional consequences.
source_does_not_establish: a judicial finding resolving every scientific and contractual dispute
identical knowledge or motive across the sponsor, hospital, university, and individual officials
the complete original correspondence and publication-decision record
a complete continuous K0 chain without field adjudication

records.matter: Final research-misconduct finding followed by retraction of falsified publications
records.institution: Office of Research Integrity / University of Texas Health Science Center

source_packets.supports: ORI found intentional falsification, fabrication, and plagiarism in published papers and manuscripts; the identified papers were retracted.

records.source_supports: A publication gate can be exercised after an institutional assessment, admission, federal oversight review, and final misconduct finding.
source_does_not_establish: that every retraction is justified
a qualified knower being reclassified for contradicting a gateholder
explanation laundering or feedback-source removal
a ceiling-conversion event

records.matter: External research-misconduct adjudication and scientific-record correction authority
records.institution: Office of Research Integrity / U.S. Department of Health and Human Services

source_packets.supports: The regulation defines findings, institutional and federal responsibilities, final action, and authority to notify journals of publications requiring correction or retraction.
A finding requires significant departure, culpable intent or recklessness, and proof by a preponderance; honest error and differences of opinion are excluded.

records.source_supports: A separated merits process can distinguish misconduct from honest error or disagreement and can correct the publication record through formal authority.
source_does_not_establish: perfect institutional independence in every case
timely protection for every complainant
that every requested retraction is implemented
observed prevention of a K0 event

records.matter: Binding authorship-conflict adjudication with factfinding, appeals, records, and retaliation prohibition
records.institution: National Institutes of Health Intramural Research Program

source_packets.supports: The policy provides informal resolution, formal factfinding, conflict screening, written binding decisions, appeal routes, record retention, anti-retaliation rules, and enforcement with journals.
The official index links authorship criteria, resources, and the conflict-resolution policy.

records.source_supports: An institution can separate authorship disputes from unilateral laboratory hierarchy and provide a binding evidence-based decision route.
source_does_not_establish: that every eligible dispute uses the process
that factfinders are externally independent
that retaliation never occurs
observed effectiveness across all NIH publications

records.matter: Department-wide scientific-integrity reporting and correction mechanism
records.institution: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services

source_packets.supports: The policy prohibits interference, supports the free flow of scientific information, provides accountability, and requires correction when a loss of scientific integrity is substantiated.
The reporting route asks for specific facts and evidence and assigns complaints to scientific-integrity officials.

records.source_supports: A designated reporting and correction route can preserve evidence and challenge interference with scientific communication outside the immediate publication gate.
source_does_not_establish: independence from all departmental leadership
a pre-action stay in every publication dispute
observed resolution times or outcomes
effective protection for every complainant

records.matter: Institutional reversal of a carelessness finding against a clinical whistleblower

source_packets.supports: Karolinska reversed a prior decision and concluded that the researcher had not been careless in the grant application at issue.

records.source_supports: An institution can later reverse a damaging classification and correct the formal record.
source_does_not_establish: timely pre-action protection
complete restoration of employment, funding, publication, or reputation
that the initial error was intentional
prevention of the underlying patient and research harms

records.matter: Public index of current federal research-misconduct cases and administrative actions

source_packets.supports: The page lists cases with currently imposed administrative actions and expressly excludes cases whose action periods have expired.

records.source_supports: The official source exposes a bounded current-case denominator and its own temporal limitation.
source_does_not_establish: a complete historical misconduct universe
all institutional inquiries that did not yield federal action
publication disputes outside PHS jurisdiction
a K0 event
